# Paying down a USD payable from a CAD bank, the payable's splits in no lot.
#
# Supplies bought on account put 100.00 USD on the payable at 1.40: the
# liability grows, which opens a liability cost basis of 100.00, split
# 0f0f0f0f0f0f0f0f0f0f0f0f0f0f0a01. Paying it down takes the payable from
# −100.00 to nothing, which consumes that cost basis, and the payment states
# it. The book ends owing nothing and holding nothing, and the cost basis has
# 0.00 left (Q-054).
#
# A payment onto a payable owing nothing is the other case: it takes the
# account above zero, where a liability acts as an asset, and opens an asset
# cost basis for the money held with the vendor.
#
# Verified by tests/integration/test_foreign_currency_cost_basis.py.
2026-01-01 open Assets
	type: Asset
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Assets:Bank
	type: Bank
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Liabilities
	type: Liability
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Liabilities:Accounts Payable USD
	type: Accounts Payable
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
2026-01-01 open Expenses
	type: Expense
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Expenses:Supplies
	type: Expense
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"

2026-01-15 * "Supplies bought on account"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Expenses:Supplies 140.00 CAD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
		share_price: "1"
		value: "140.00"
	Liabilities:Accounts Payable USD -100.00 USD
		guid: "0f0f0f0f0f0f0f0f0f0f0f0f0f0f0a01"
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
		share_price: "1.40"
		value: "-140.00"

2026-02-01 * "Pay down the USD payable"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Liabilities:Accounts Payable USD 100.00 USD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
		share_price: "1.40"
		value: "140.00"
		cost_basis_split_guid: "0f0f0f0f0f0f0f0f0f0f0f0f0f0f0a01"
	Assets:Bank -140.00 CAD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
		share_price: "1"
		value: "-140.00"
